title: School settings
description: The school’s currency, time zone and language, and the late-cancellation rules. Owners and admins can change them.

currency.label: School currency
currency.hint: One currency for prices, packages and payments. After a change, the prices in your price list (session types, package templates) get the new currency while the amounts stay the same, so please review them.
currency.locked: The currency is locked because the school already has packages, charges or payments. Changing it would change the meaning of the recorded amounts. If this is a mistake, write to support via “Report a problem or idea”.

timezone.label: Time zone
timezone.hint: We use it for session times, the billing day and reminders.

locale.label: School language
locale.hint: Messages to people without an account, such as email invitations, are sent in this language. People with an account see the app in their own language.

hours.label: Late cancellation: hours before the session
hours.hint: A cancellation made later than this many hours before the start counts as “late”. 0 means no limit.

consumes.label: A late cancellation uses up a package session
consumes.hint: Turn off if late cancellations should not charge the client’s package.

validation.locale: Choose one of the available languages.
validation.late_cancel_hours: Enter a number of hours from 0 to {max}.
